rules.choice: At hero creation, take a holding or join your class's guild.
rules.guild_gives: A shared hall to Safe Rest in, one contact in the guild, one specialty from the guild's skill, and the guild as a door that sends you jobs.
rules.cost: The guild's ask, every arc. Skip it for a whole arc and drop a rank; an Apprentice who skips it is out.
ranks: Journeyman: meet the ask once and finish one gig for the guild; receive your class arcanum or the lead to it.
Master: take a side in the guild's split and win the vote; you hold the guild's seat.
rules.class_lock: A guild gives its arcanum only to its own class. Another class gets the contact, the specialty and the jobs.
rules.prep: Each guild is one index card. It gets a faction clock only when a player's choice makes it matter.
rules.pressures: The Golden Council charters guilds; the University wants them as trade chapters; the Black Hand sells counterfeit charters to gray guilds (campaign overview).

guilds.name: The Red Sand
guilds.master: Sytheria Redsong, the arena's master of ceremonies
guilds.wants: to rule on trial by mortal combat for the Black Hand's condemned as a guild verdict, not as the Black Hand's mercy
guilds.keeps: the Bout Rolls, every fighter's record and how they lost
guilds.split: the Blood (to the death, for the crowd's money) against the Sand (first blood, for the fighters)
guilds.asks: one bout per arc; the guild takes a cut
guilds.gives: the lead: the Rolls name the fallen Borderlands fighter, and the guild has the collector's address
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The House
guilds.master: Gleaming Guildred, the dwarf priest of luck, coin and merriment
guilds.wants: the Council's license for every game of chance in the city
guilds.keeps: the Marks Book, who is rich and who is desperate
guilds.split: the House (honest odds, steady coin) against the Sharps (the guild's best are cheats)
guilds.gives: the lead: the House knows the card sharp, and which Golden Knights shelf the die left
guilds.rival: the Black Hand, which taxes every table
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Muster
guilds.master: Joslyn Halfcloak, the Knights' contact for hired help
guilds.wants: a standing commission for free companies, since the Knights are about two hundred strong and already hire outsiders
guilds.teeth: strips the commission of captains who abandon their troops
guilds.keeps: the Muster Roll, every sellsword company and its debts
guilds.split: Knights-first (serve the Order) against the Free Captains (serve the highest bidder)
guilds.gives: a writ to take the Battle Standard from the Museum of Worlds Beyond's vault
guilds.rival: the Seekers of the Sun, who hold it
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Wardens' Lodge
guilds.wants: bounty rights on the Suntouched Highway and Predalion's Belt
guilds.teeth: hunts poachers and guides who sell out caravans
guilds.keeps: the Track Book, the sign of every beast and band on the roads
guilds.split: the Wardens (keep the roads) against the Bounty-takers (paid per head)
guilds.gives: the Borderlands Tracking Cord itself; wardens took it off the merchant's body
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The University
guilds.wants: a monopoly: open lectures, then licensing, then the only key-readers in the city (campaign overview)
guilds.teeth: an enforcement wing of ex-adventurers (campaign overview)
guilds.split: Traditionalists, Royalists and a New School (campaign overview)
guilds.asks: your findings, published as its own
guilds.gives: the name of the pawn shop holding the Cracked Lens of Kartan; the University reported it stolen, and lets a Reader-rank student who recovers it keep it on loan
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Sworn Chapter
guilds.wants: sworn knights recognized as judges in their own right
guilds.keeps: the Book of Oaths, every oath sworn before the Golden Throne
guilds.split: Throne-sworn (the queen) against Law-sworn (the Council's law); canon's plot by the queen's sister Atretha gives it a live edge
guilds.gives: a lead to the old court ruin in Sunken Revvia where the Broken Verdict lies
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Hollow Circle
guilds.wants: pacts made lawful, so a pact-bound caster is not a criminal by default
guilds.teeth: hunts members whose patrons come through
guilds.keeps: the Margin Book, every patron's known terms
guilds.split: the Bound (keep their patrons) against the Reavers (cut free)
guilds.gives: the address of the sealed room where the Hollow Contract lies
guilds.rival: the Children of Ibraxus, who recruit the same people
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Sisters' Vigil
guilds.master: Grace Ebonlight, who directs the temple
guilds.wants: the right to tend every dying body in the city, the Lower Reaches included
guilds.keeps: the Roll of the Dead, who is buried where on the Cliffs
guilds.split: the Temple (heal for faith) against the Market (heal for coin)
guilds.asks: one vigil per arc at a sickbed or grave (also the Bell's refill)
guilds.gives: where the Bell of the Three Sisters is; the temple never consecrated it, and the Vigil lends it to the member who brings it in
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Whisper Company
guilds.master: Kaylex Thren, the dragonborn minstrel who runs it
guilds.wants: a place at the queen's court
guilds.teeth: blacklists performers who sell what they hear backstage without the Company's leave
guilds.keeps: the Prompt Books, every play and who sat in the audience
guilds.split: the Players (perform) against the Whisperers (sell what they hear to Roselyn Zeshe)
guilds.asks: one performance per arc, and anything you overhear

guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Grove Circle

guilds.teeth: hunts poachers and anyone who brings beasts through the arches

guilds.asks: tend the Grove one night per arc
guilds.gives: the Mud from the Revlend Marshes itself; the arch-traveller left the jar with the Grove
guilds.rival: the Golden Council, which ignores the outer lands
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.

guilds.name: The Last Studio
guilds.hall: the studio in the Lower Reaches from the Wrappings card
guilds.master: none: the last teacher stopped mid-sentence
guilds.teeth: hunts whoever silenced the last teacher
guilds.split: two senior students, each claiming the last teacher's line
guilds.gives: the key to the locked case where the Wrappings lie
guilds.rival: the Red Sand, which poaches students
guilds.canon: Hall is canon (3_gazetteer, Locations by Class, or the card). Name, wants, teeth, split, asks and any master's guild role are new canon.
